home.aboutLeidenDesc: A city full of history, science and stories. Discover what makes Leiden so special.
home.historyP1: Leiden is one of the oldest cities in the Netherlands, located on the Old Rhine. The city has a rich history dating back to Roman times.
home.historyP2: Leiden is world-famous as a university city (founded in 1575 as a reward for brave resistance during the Spanish siege), as the birthplace of Rembrandt, and as the home of the Pilgrim Fathers before they departed for America.
home.historyP3: Today, Leiden is a vibrant city with a compact, historic centre full of canals, courtyards, museums and stories on every corner.
home.whyPoint1: A tour guide costs around {price} per person
home.whyPoint2: You can't stop when you want to
home.whyPoint3: No time to really look around
home.withAppTitle: With the app, you do it your way
home.withAppPoint1: Read, listen and watch everything in your own language
home.withAppPoint2: Stop wherever you want, for as long as you want
home.withAppPoint3: Perfect for children - fun, educational, no big groups
home.withAppPoint4: Discover hidden gems no guide will show you
home.tip1: Leiden is best explored on foot or by bicycle. The centre is compact and largely car-free.
home.tip2: On Wednesdays and Saturdays there is a market on the Nieuwe Rijn and Botermarkt. The perfect combination with the Centre Route.
home.tip3: Leiden Centraal station is well connected to the rest of the Netherlands. From the station it's a 10-minute walk to the centre.
home.tip4: Most attractions are free to visit. Only museums charge admission.
home.faq1A: After purchasing the Leiden package, you get access to all routes and locations. At each location you can watch interactive videos, read stories and discover the city at your own pace.
home.faq2Q: How long do I have access?
home.faq2A: You have lifetime access to the Leiden package. All future routes and updates are included.
home.faq3Q: Can I use the routes offline?
home.faq3A: The routes and stories are available online. An internet connection is needed to load the videos and content.
home.faq4A: All routes are kid-friendly. The interactive videos are also fun and educational for children.
home.ctaDesc: From 5.99 per person. All routes, videos and hidden gems. At your pace.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.intro: YourLocalCityGuide respects your privacy. This page explains which data is used on your device and when external services are contacted.
privacyPage.storedAccount: The demo sign-in status is stored locally in your browser.
privacyPage.storedRoutes: Saved routes and visited stops are stored locally.
privacyPage.storedConsent: Your privacy choice is stored locally so the notice does not reappear every time.
privacyPage.locationText: Your location is requested only after you choose to share it. It is used to order routes and is not stored by the app or sent to our server.
privacyPage.offlineText: A service worker temporarily stores previously opened pages and local images on your device. You can remove this cache in your browser's site settings.
privacyPage.servicesMap: The interactive map loads map tiles from OpenFreeMap. The provider receives technical connection data such as your IP address.
privacyPage.servicesGoogle: Google Maps opens only when you press a navigation link yourself.
privacyPage.servicesNewsletter: When you subscribe to the newsletter, your email address is processed by Resend after consent. You can unsubscribe at any time.
privacyPage.cookiesText: No advertising or analytics cookies are currently active. Essential browser storage supports the app's core functions.
privacyPage.contactText: Questions about this privacy policy? Contact us at

offline.message: You are offline. Routes opened earlier remain available; new content will load when your connection returns.

privacyConsent.description: We use essential local storage for sign-in, saved routes, progress and offline use.
privacyConsent.optionalNote: No advertising or analytics cookies are currently active. Your choice is stored locally on this device.
